about_short_description.short_description: Qapa is a job matching marketplace that connects job seekers and recruiters with a matching algorithm.

product.name: QAPA Mobile Application
product.description: A mobile app that allows users to manage their temporary work assignments, apply for jobs, sign contracts, view pay slips, and request advances.

product.name: Job Matching Algorithm
product.description: An algorithm that analyzes user experiences and qualifications to automatically suggest relevant job offers via email, SMS, and voice messages.

product.name: Temporary Work Management
product.description: A service that handles all aspects of temporary work assignments, including contracts, work hours tracking, pay slips, and salary payments.

product.name: Sector-Specific Job Offers
product.description: Job offers available across various sectors such as logistics, commerce, industry, health, and banking throughout France.

product.name: Candidate Alerts
product.description: Email and SMS alerts sent to candidates when a job matching their profile becomes available.

product.name: Document Management
product.description: A feature allowing users to upload and manage necessary documents like CVs, identity papers, and social security cards.
